I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small bean plot because money is tight, and for beans I usually manage with the soil we have and some manure if I can get it. Since the plot is small and intercropped, I will plant my usual local seed and rely on family work for planting and weeding. I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use pesticide unless there is a serious problem, which is not common for me.
